page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server type includes 893 GB of local SSD storage bundled directly with the instance. For network connectivity, it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the inclusion of local SSD storage alongside a balanced vCPU-to-memory ratio makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring fast local read and write operations without the overhead of external network-attached storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. Appropriate workloads include relational databases, NoSQL databases, local caching layers, and general-purpose applications requiring moderate local storage performance.
